changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create table api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null,
SubjectUid uniqueidentifier null, Subject varchar(50) null, SubjectID int null,
ObjectUid uniqueidentifier null, Object varchar(50) null, ObjectID int null,
IntersectID int null, [Message] nvarchar(2500) null, Success bit null, IsNew bit null, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionRelationship] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, ItemNumber ASC ) ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_SubjectUid ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [SubjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_ObjectUid ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [ObjectUid] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionRelationship_Success ON api.ExecutionRelationship ( ExecutionID DESC, [Success] ASC ) INCLUDE ( ItemNumber );

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create table api.ExecutionField ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null, FieldName nvarchar(250) not null, FieldValue nvarchar(max) null, FieldTypeID int null, LookupValue nvarchar(max) null, Ignore bit null CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, ItemNumber ASC, FieldName ASC ) ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionField_ItemNumber_Include ON api.ExecutionField ( ExecutionID DESC, ItemNumber ASC ) INCLUDE ( FieldTypeID );
